product_overview: GarageMate is a cross-platform (iOS, Android, Web) Expo app for discovering, saving, and posting local garage sales. It uses Firebase for auth, Firestore and Storage for data, geohash radius queries for nearby results, and platform-conditional maps (react-native-maps on native, react-leaflet on web).
core_goals: Allow authenticated users to discover nearby garage sales via list and map views.
Enable users to create, edit, and manage listings with images, address autocomplete and validation.
Support standard auth flows (Email/Password with verification, Google, Apple on iOS) and auth-gated navigation.
Provide saved items and profile management (display name, email/password updates for password users).
Ensure listings auto-expire via a scheduled Cloud Function and enforce Firestore security rules.

features.name: Firebase Initialisation
features.description: Initialise a single Firebase app and export auth, Firestore (db) and storage instances from lib/firebase.ts so the app can silently connect to backend services on app load.
user_flows: App loads -> Firebase initialises silently -> auth, db, and storage instances become available
App loads -> Firebase initialisation fails due to missing/invalid credentials -> Developer sees console error / app shows error banner indicating backend unavailable

features.name: Root Navigation Shell
features.description: File-based Expo Router root layout with an auth group and a tabs group. Provides 5 main tabs: Home, Map, Add, Saved, Profile, with auth-gated routing.
user_flows: Open app as authenticated user -> Router shows main tab navigator -> Tap Home tab -> Navigate to /(tabs)/index -> Tap Map tab -> Navigate to /(tabs)/map -> Tap Add tab -> Navigate to /(tabs)/add -> Tap Saved tab -> Navigate to /(tabs)/saved -> Tap Profile tab -> Navigate to /(tabs)/profile
Open app as unauthenticated user -> Root layout detects no auth -> Router redirects to /(auth)/login -> See Login screen

features.name: Authentication (Login / Register / Forgot Password / Google / Apple)
features.description: Email/Password login and register with email verification, Google Sign-In, Apple Sign-In on iOS, forgot-password flow, and an auth gate that routes users based on onAuthStateChanged via useAuth hook.
user_flows: Navigate to /(auth)/login -> Fill Email field -> Fill Password field -> Tap Sign In button -> Firebase authenticates user -> Router redirects to /(tabs)/index -> See Home screen

Navigate to /(auth)/login -> Tap 'Don't have an account? Register' link -> Navigate to /(auth)/register -> Fill required fields -> Tap Create Account -> Firebase creates account and sendEmailVerification -> See verification sent screen
Navigate to /(auth)/login -> Tap 'Forgot password?' -> Navigate to /(auth)/forgot-password -> Enter Email -> Tap Send Reset Link -> Firebase sends reset email -> See confirmation screen
Navigate to /(auth)/login -> Tap 'Continue with Google' -> Google Sign-In flow completes -> Firebase signInWithCredential -> Router redirects to /(tabs)/index
On iOS: Navigate to /(auth)/login -> Tap Apple sign-in button -> Complete Apple auth -> Firebase signInWithCredential -> Router redirects to /(tabs)/index
Navigate to /(auth)/login -> Leave Email or Password empty -> Tap Sign In button -> See error message 'Please enter your email and password.'
Navigate to /(auth)/login -> Fill Email and Password with wrong credentials -> Tap Sign In button -> Firebase rejects auth -> See error 'Invalid email or password.'
Navigate to /(auth)/login -> Authenticate with email/password but email is unverified -> Tap Sign In -> See error 'Please verify your email before signing in.'
Attempt any auth action -> Network outage occurs -> See network error message 'Network error. Please check your connection.'

features.name: Home Screen & Listing Detail
features.description: Home (/ (tabs)/index) lists nearby active listings using geohash-based Firestore queries (useListings hook). Includes date filters, adjustable radius slider, suburb search fallback, listing card list, pagination, and a shared Listing Detail screen (/listing/{id}) with images, description, save toggle and maps deep-link.
user_flows: Navigate to /(tabs)/index -> App requests location permission -> Grant permission -> useListings runs geohash queries -> Listings load and are displayed as ListingCard items
Navigate to /(tabs)/index -> App requests location permission -> Deny permission -> See suburb search input -> Enter suburb -> Select suggestion -> Center set and useListings runs -> Listings load
On /(tabs)/index -> Adjust radius slider -> useListings refetches for new radius -> List updates accordingly
On /(tabs)/index -> Tap a ListingCard -> Router pushes /listing/{id} -> Listing detail fetches listing from Firestore -> See images carousel, title, times, address and Save button
On /listing/{id} -> Tap Save button -> Hook toggles saved state -> users/{uid}/saved/{listingId} is created -> See Save button state update

Navigate to /(tabs)/index -> Tap ListingCard for a removed or inactive listing -> Router pushes /listing/{id} -> Firestore read denied or returns not found -> See 'This listing is no longer available.' message

features.name: Map Screen (Native + Web)
features.description: Map screen (/ (tabs)/map) renders react-native-maps on iOS/Android and react-leaflet on Web, shows nearby listings as annotations/markers (useListings with fixed 20km radius), and displays a bottom sheet card on annotation tap with a 'View Details' action.
user_flows: Navigate to /(tabs)/map -> App requests location permission -> Grant permission -> Map component mounts centered on user location -> Markers render for nearby listings
On /(tabs)/map -> Tap a marker/annotation -> Selected listing state set -> Bottom sheet card appears with title and address -> Tap 'View Details' -> Router navigates to /listing/{id}
Navigate to /(tabs)/map -> Deny location permission -> See message 'Location permission required to show the map.' -> Option to grant permission or use suburb search
Open web in browser -> Navigate to /(tabs)/map -> react-leaflet map loads -> Markers render -> Click marker -> Popup shows -> Click popup link -> Router navigates to /listing/{id}

features.name: Add Listing (Create & Edit)
features.description: Add listing screen (/ (tabs)/add) supports creating and editing listings: image picker (max 3), Google Places address autocomplete (lat/lng + geohash), date/time pickers, form validation, upload new images to Firebase Storage and create/update Firestore listing documents atomically. Edit mode pre-fills fields and preserves existing image URLs.
user_flows: Navigate to /(tabs)/add -> Tap + Photo -> Pick up to 3 images -> Fill Title and Description -> Select Address via autocomplete -> Pick Start Date and Start/End Times -> Tap Add Listing -> App uploads images to Firebase Storage -> Firestore createListing called -> Router redirects to /(tabs)/index -> New listing appears in Home list

Navigate to /(tabs)/add in edit mode with listingId -> Existing images display as thumbnails -> Remove an existing image and add a new local image -> Update Title -> Tap Save Changes -> App uploads only new images -> updateListing called -> Router redirects to /(tabs)/index
Navigate to /(tabs)/add -> Submit form with no images or empty required fields -> validateListingForm returns errors -> Display inline validation messages and do not proceed

Navigate to /(tabs)/add -> Fill valid form -> During image upload a network/storage error occurs -> Upload fails -> Show error alert 'Failed to save listing. Please try again.' -> No partial listing is created

features.name: Saved Screen & Profile
features.description: Saved screen (/ (tabs)/saved) lists user's saved items by resolving users/{uid}/saved/* to listing docs and showing active/ended/unavailable states. Profile (/ (tabs)/profile) shows displayName and email, allows sign out, links to Edit Profile and My Listings. Edit Profile supports display name updates for all users and email/password updates for Email/Password users requiring reauthentication.
user_flows: Navigate to /(tabs)/saved -> Hook fetches users/{uid}/saved -> For each saved listingId fetch listing -> Active listings render as ListingCard
On /(tabs)/saved -> Tap an active ListingCard -> Router navigates to /listing/{id}
On /(tabs)/saved -> Saved listing doc exists but listing.active == false -> Render placeholder 'This sale has ended.'
Navigate to /(tabs)/profile -> See display name and email -> Tap 'Edit Profile' -> Navigate to /edit-profile -> Change display name -> Tap Save Name -> updateProfile succeeds -> See confirmation
Navigate to /(tabs)/profile -> Tap 'Sign Out' -> signOut(auth) called -> Router redirects to /(auth)/login

Navigate to /edit-profile for Email/Password user -> Enter current password and new email -> Tap Update Email -> reauthenticateWithCredential succeeds -> verifyBeforeUpdateEmail sends verification -> See confirmation that verification email was sent
Attempt email/password update with wrong current password -> reauthenticateWithCredential fails -> See error 'Current password is incorrect.'

features.name: Cloud Function: Auto-Expiry
features.description: Scheduled Firebase Cloud Function (expireListedSales) runs daily (scheduled cron) and sets active=false for listings where expiresAt < now and active == true; the expiry logic chunks updates to respect Firestore batch limits.
user_flows: Developer deploys functions -> firebase deploy --only functions -> Scheduled function expireListedSales is deployed successfully

Scheduled function triggers at scheduled UTC time -> expireListings queries listings where expiresAt < now AND active == true -> Batch updates set active=false for expired docs -> Logs show 'expireListings complete' and expired listings no longer appear in Home or Map
Deploy attempt fails due to invalid credentials or build error -> Deploy returns error -> Developer sees deployment error and function not scheduled
Scheduled run encounters an internal error (e.g. transient Firestore permission issue) -> Function logs error and aborts -> Expiry is retried or manually re-run after fix
